headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.7
summary: The animated background lineup grows to eleven effects with a dropdown picker, and effects now follow accent color changes instantly.

items.text: Seven new animated background effects — Warp, Ripple, Bubbles, Fireflies, Aurora, Synthwave, and Comet — join Matrix, Donut, Fireworks, and Wave.
The Animated background picker is now a dropdown, so all eleven effects fit on narrow screens.
Vietnamese labels for every background effect.
Accent color changes now update the running background effect immediately instead of waiting for the next screen recreate.
